## Summary

Implemented the Pi executor harness (change 060, task 1).

**Source (all in scope):**
- `config-pi.ts` — `PiConfig`/validation, `PI_TESTED_RANGE`, `assessPiVersion`, `runPiAuthCheck`, `resolvePiBinary`/`resolvePiEffort`, and the `diagnosePi` hook with the `HarnessDiagnoseContext`/`HarnessDiagnosis` port.
- `config-env.ts` — moved `applyHarnessModelEnv` out to keep `config.ts` under budget; `config.ts` accepts/merges `pi` and re-exports `PiConfig`.
- `harness-catalog.ts` — registers `pi` (planner.agent unsupported, env-model only when selected, diagnose hook) and holds `resolvePiModel` (harness-name comparison must not sit in `config*.ts`).
- `src/harness/pi/` — `pi-args.ts` (exact headless argv + shared prompt), `pi-stream.ts`/`pi-tools.ts` (LF-only translation of tool/text/tokens/file_changed/harness_retry plus settle handling), `pi.ts` (`PiAdapter`, `preflightPi`, kill grace, missing-credentials hint).
- `types.ts`/`spawn.ts` — `SpawnDetails` on `onSpawn`, `harness_retry`, `started.harnessVersion`, `tokens.provider/model`, forwarded into the `started` event.
- `harness/index.ts`, `src/index.ts` — registration and public exports.

**Tests:** `tests/pi/` (config, stream, adapter, watcher) plus a fake `pi` and replay fixtures, and the captured `tests/fixtures/pi/run.jsonl`.

**Notable deviations (recorded in the result):** resolution/diagnose placement had to avoid the frozen architecture guard and a module cycle; the golden fixture was absent, so I captured and stripped a real Pi 0.87.0 run to create it.
